recipes.mechanism_narrative: civil_war_and_insurgency predicts active-conflict onset or escalation. The D2 multi-task head — trained on indicators including battle-related deaths, refugee flows, internal displacement, political polarization, and fiscal-capacity collapse — learns a multi-indicator signature of state stress that precedes open conflict by 1-3 years. The D5 trajectory features were within hysteresis (+0.003 LOCO) so D2 is preserved; civil-war signals are predominantly level-based (a country IS in/near civil war or is NOT) rather than rate-of-change-based, which is why D5 trajectory features didn't add meaningful signal.

recipes.mechanism_narrative: multilateral_agreement predicts a country joining or substantively engaging with multi-party international agreements (climate, trade, security). Under D2, this recipe was FALSIFIED on F2 (in-sample AUC 0.5649 was below the 0.57 threshold) despite LOCO 0.7493. Under D5, trajectory features on diplomatic-engagement indicators (treaty participation rates, sovereignty index changes, multilateral-forum representation deltas) provided the in-sample signal that level features alone could not — multilateral agreement is an event-driven recipe where the *change in diplomatic posture* matters more than the absolute level. The D5 rescue is genuine: F1+F2+LOCO all pass; the +0.120 LOCO lift from D2 baseline is the architecture's strongest validation case.

recipes.mechanism_narrative: elections_and_voting predicts national-election outcomes — contested elections, post-election violence, contested transfers of power, electoral-system reforms. The D5 head uses V-Dem electoral indicators (free-and-fair-election index, civil-society participation, freedom of expression) and political-participation trajectory features. The +0.042 LOCO lift from D2 reflects modest trajectory-feature contribution; elections are partly trajectory-driven (the rate of democratic backsliding matters) but also strongly level-driven (institutional quality at baseline). Largest n_pos_test = 14 of any STRONG/MODERATE LOCK — among the most statistically-stable LOCKs.

advisory_only_disclosure_language.binding_text: Tier: {STRONG/MODERATE} under {D2/D5} (LOCO {value}). Actuarial use restriction: LOCO statistic is computed on n_pos_loco = 1 (sole positive in the LOCO partition). This recipe is classified ADVISORY-ONLY for standalone pricing until a repeat LOCO walk confirms the tier on n_pos_loco ≥ 2. May be used as a supporting signal in multi-recipe composite scores, but SHALL NOT be the sole basis for a political-risk pricing recommendation.
advisory_only_disclosure_language.rationale: Lloyd's RDS guidance, ICA framework, and Solvency II internal model validation each require that discrimination metrics for pricing-grade use rest on multiple observations. A discrimination metric computed on a single event is a point estimate with an unbounded confidence interval — not a validated statistic. Presenting these as STRONG without an ADVISORY-ONLY flag is a material misrepresentation risk.
